mapper.select: SELECT product, label, category, version_command, source_url, fetched_at, fetch_status FROM compat_product ORDER BY product

SELECT release_id, product, version, label, release_date, is_lts AS lts, is_eol AS eol, eol_date, ext_support_date, is_maintained AS maintained, latest_version, min_java_version, is_manual AS manual FROM compat_release
SELECT version FROM compat_release WHERE product = #{product} AND is_manual = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO compat_release (product, version, label, release_date, is_lts, is_eol, eol_date, ext_support_date, is_maintained, latest_version, min_java_version, is_manual) VALUES (#{product}, #{version}, #{label}, #{releaseDate}, #{lts}, #{eol}, #{eolDate}, #{extSupportDate}, #{maintained}, #{latestVersion}, #{minJavaVersion}, #{manual}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE label = VALUES(label), release_date = VALUES(release_date), is_lts = VALUES(is_lts), is_eol = VALUES(is_eol), eol_date = VALUES(eol_date), ext_support_date = VALUES(ext_support_date), is_maintained = VALUES(is_maintained), latest_version = VALUES(latest_version), min_java_version = VALUES(min_java_version)
